observations.finding: Conditional futureMetadata writer emits the standard dynamic-array extension URI and dynamic/collapsed flags; another branch writes rich-value future metadata.
observations.implementedIndependently: Standard XLDAPR cell metadata roundtrip; unknown rich-value metadata remains an explicit fidelity boundary.

observations.finding: Workbook metadata-part creation, metadata types, future metadata and cell metadata are separate writer stages.
A name-enumeration/filter path distinguishes xlfn and wpsfn prefixes; this does not establish complete formula parsing or evaluation semantics.
Serialization path handles layout/follow identifiers, transition, timing, theme override and color mapping as separate fields; indirect callees and complete motion behavior remain unresolved.

Five bounded native paths cover footnote-part acquisition/content indexing, field begin/separator/end, section import and revision property association. The report separates observations from inferred semantics.

A formula optimization result path assembles source/optimized expressions, their durations, sheet/range, first-cell value and a separate dynamic-array flag into a suggestion list. This is diagnostic/result presentation evidence, not the formula evaluator or spill algorithm.

Retained pseudocode inspected through two pages identifies command registration, including put_Date1904. Its callback address is not a recovered Ghidra procedure; the date setter algorithm remains unresolved. Registration does not prove date conversion semantics.

An actual revision rendering path conditionally installs a revision-field filter according to capability/current state, then restores prior filtering. Eleven indirect calls remain unresolved; complete revision layout/history is not established.

A table-transpose impact/confirmation path includes annotations, bookmarks, fields, revisions and recalculation. It is not the acceptance-of-revisions algorithm. Sixty-five indirect calls and truncated value-flow observations limit further inference.

limitations: Default Ghidra auto-analysis completion is not proof that every function, runtime path or WPS feature was understood or reconstructed.
Missing original symbols, unresolved indirect calls, compiler transformations and packed/undefined strings limit static results.
Initial 20-minute imports for the two largest engines timed out; separate retries use a 60-minute deadline and retain the original failures.
No WPS binaries, private implementation, icons or vendor templates are included in product builds; public OOXML specifications and independent fixtures drive implementation.
Exact pagination/fonts, every formula parameter, dynamic spilling, full native revision history and every cloud/team feature have not been proven equivalent.
